title: dSABRE: A SABRE-Style Router for Multi-Core Distributed Quantum Computers
summary: Minimising EPR consumption is the dominant objective when routing a quantum circuit on a distributed quantum computer (DQC). We present dSABRE, a SABRE-style router for multi-core processors that, on each iteration of a lookahead-driven loop, first resolves any intra-core front-layer gates by SWAP scoring and only falls back to scoring inter-core teleportation candidates when the intra-core front is empty.
